description: Emoji-to-icon matches for ninjas.cl. Each entry records which static icon replaces an emoji in the site chrome, where it is used, and why. Chile, ninja, heart, and flying-saucer emojis are kept as emojis per the site owner.

matches.label: Inicio
matches.description: The Windows desktop icon — the home screen — replaces the house emoji for the home page link.

matches.label: Blog
matches.used_in: navbar Blog link; Entradas del blog section title
matches.description: The classic Notepad icon stands for written entries.

matches.label: Nosotros / Sobre nosotros
matches.used_in: navbar Nosotros link; Sobre nosotros section title
matches.description: The Direct3D flower box icon — the pack's flower — keeps the blossom.

matches.label: Proyectos
matches.used_in: navbar Proyectos link; Proyectos section title
matches.description: A light bulb for ideas and projects — the crystal ball's nearest neighbour in the pack.

matches.label: Libros
matches.used_in: navbar Libros link; Libros section title
matches.description: The pack's open book, for the books section.

matches.label: Juegos
matches.used_in: navbar Juegos link; Juegos section title
matches.description: The Minesweeper icon — the iconic Windows 95 game.

matches.label: Elixir Chile
matches.description: The Registration Wizard icon for the wizard emoji.

matches.label: Joy of ProcessWire
matches.used_in: Joy of ProcessWire showcase card title
matches.description: The FastBoot icon — speed and launch — for the rocket.

matches.label: Proyecto Chaucha
matches.description: A quartz crystal stands in for the coin.

matches.label: Entrada destacada
matches.description: The star for the featured entry.

matches.label: Advertencias de entrada
matches.description: The Windows warning icon leads the post page's caution notices.

matches.label: Anterior
matches.description: The Windows hand, rotated a quarter turn counter-clockwise, points back to the newer post.

matches.label: Siguiente
matches.description: The Windows hand, rotated a quarter turn clockwise, points on to the older post.

matches.label: Tags de entrada
matches.description: The Windows bookmark icon leads the post's tag labels.
